question: Where was the National Cross-Country Championships held on January 12, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **59th National Cross Country Championships** were held in **Meerut**, **Uttar Pradesh**, on **January 12, 2025**.
 
• This prestigious athletic event was organized under the aegis of the **Athletics Federation of India (AFI)** in collaboration with the **Uttar Pradesh Athletics Association**.
 
• The championships featured various categories, including the **Men's 10km**, **Women's 10km**, as well as **Under-20**, **Under-18**, and **Under-16** age groups for both boys and girls.
 
• The event served as the official selection trials for the Indian national team to participate in the upcoming **Asian Cross Country Championships**.
 
• Athletes from all over the country, representing different **States**, **Union Territories**, and units like the **Services Sports Control Board (SSCB)** and **Railways**, competed on the natural terrain courses designed for the meet. ***Hence, the correct answer is Uttar Pradesh.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Athletics Federation of India (AFI):**
 
 
• The **AFI** is the apex body for athletics in India, responsible for the management and promotion of track and field sports. It was established in **1946**.
 
• It is affiliated with **World Athletics** and the **Asian Athletics Association**, ensuring that Indian athletes follow international standards.
 
 
 
• **Cross-Country Running:**
 
 
• This is a specific discipline of long-distance running where individuals and teams run on open-air courses over natural terrain such as **grass**, **dirt**, and **mud**.
 
• Unlike track events, cross-country relies on the ability of the athlete to adapt to uneven surfaces and varying weather conditions.
 
 
 
• **Venue Significance:**
 
 
• **Meerut** is often referred to as the **Sports City of India** due to its massive sports goods manufacturing industry.
 
• Hosting the **National Cross Country Championships** in **Meerut** highlights **Uttar Pradesh's** growing infrastructure for national-level sporting events.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Strategic Selection:** The championship date, **January 12**, coincided with **National Youth Day**, celebrating the birth anniversary of **Swami Vivekananda**, which inspired many young participants.
 
• **State Initiatives:** The government of **Uttar Pradesh** has been promoting sports through schemes like **One District One Sport (ODOS)** and the construction of the **Major Dhyan Chand Sports University** in **Meerut**.
 
• **Qualifying Standards:** Top performers in the **2025** meet were shortlisted for national camps to prepare for international competitions in **China** and other global venues.
 
• **Historical Context:** Previous editions of the National Cross Country Championships have been hosted in states like **Nagaland (Kohima)** and **Haryana**, showing a pan-India rotation of the event.
